observations: Black UPS with a blue vertical strip on the front panel.
Brand 'BLUE GATE' is embossed on the front top (photo 0, photo 1).
Front panel features a power button and three indicator LEDs.
Power cable with a standard 3-pin plug is attached (photo 1).

claims.evidence: No photo of the internal battery or a dated purchase receipt.

Warranty seals are not shown, and internal condition is unknown.

risks.proof: Photo of the specification sticker on the back or bottom of the unit.
Video of the UPS powering a known load (like a fan or lamp) while the main power is unplugged.

proof_requests: Photo of the sticker on the back or bottom showing the model name and VA capacity.
Photo of the back panel to see the state of the output sockets.
Video of the unit turned on and running a device while unplugged from the wall.
response.reason: The model and VA capacity are not visible; Blue Gate uses this chassis for multiple models with vastly different prices. Functional status and battery health are also unproven.
